title: Header claims thread-safe stats but implementation is racy
description:
File: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/tx_queue.h
Line: 208

Line 208 documents tx_queue_stats_get as 'Thread-safe atomic copy under lock' but the implementation (tx_queue.c:416-430) explicitly does NOT acquire the lock and comments 'This read is not atomic with respect to concurrent writes.' Callers trusting the header's thread-safety claim may experience data races (undefined behavior in C).
close_reason: Fixed: tx_queue_stats_get now acquires lock before copying stats, matching the header's thread-safety documentation. Pattern matches tx_queue_count and tx_queue_empty.
